services.desc: Join Lowcounty Watersports for this unique Kayak & Coffee Tour! 1 hour 30 minutes Fun included: -Experienced guide/naturalist to guide you through HHI waterways -Glide through marsh areas/Broad Creek -Enjoy a coffee, tea, or hot chocolate to enjoy along the way -Learn more about the Hilton Head ecosystem -Possibility of seeing wildlife including pelican, osprey, heron, dolphin, egret and more Requirements Single Kayaks - Must be 14 years old + Weight limit for Single or Tandem Kayak - 400lbs Minimum age to participate is 5 years 1.5 Hours
